body:
Is an image resource used as a sampler uniform regard as same as an image uniform while calculating the pipeline graph?

In the blur dispatch, since the output texture is down-scaled, I use the input image as a sampler in the compute shader. 
The resource usage is as follow:
1. [Blur horizontal] Input: screen_texture (sampler) -> Output: h_blurred_texture (image)
2. [Blur vertical] Input: h_blurred_texture (sampler) -> Output: v_blurred_texture (image)
3. [Output] Input: screen_texture (sampler) & v_blurred_texture (sampler) -> Output: screen_texture (image)

I've just added the screen texture as an unused image uniform into the blur compute shader. i.e.
1. [Blur horizontal] Input: screen_texture (sampler) & screen_texture (image) -> Output: h_blurred_texture (image)
2. [Blur vertical] Input: h_blurred_texture (sampler) & screen_texture (image) -> Output: v_blurred_texture (image)
3. [Output] Input: screen_texture (sampler) & v_blurred_texture (sampler) -> Output: screen_texture (image)

The final output shows correctly.
